items.source: Value object to prepare HttpHeaders for PersistentEntityResource and PersistentEntity instances.
items.translation: 用于为 HttpHeaders 以及 PersistentEntityResource 和 PersistentEntity 实例准备值对象。

items.source: A Spring HATEOAS EntityModel subclass that holds a reference to the entity's PersistentEntity metadata.
items.translation: 一个 Spring HATEOAS 的 EntityModel 子类，它持有对实体 PersistentEntity 元数据的引用。

items.source: RepresentationModelAssembler to create PersistentEntityResources for arbitrary domain objects.
items.translation: RepresentationModelAssembler 用于为任意领域对象创建 PersistentEntityResource。

items.source: RequestMappingHandlerMapping implementation that will only find a handler method if a Repository is exported under that URL path segment.
items.translation: 一个RequestMappingHandlerMapping实现，它仅在Repository在该 URL 路径段下导出时才会找到处理器方法。

items.source: A custom RepresentationModel type to be able to write custom RepresentationModelProcessors to add additional links to ones automatically exposed for Spring Data repository query methods.
items.translation: 自定义一个RepresentationModel类型，以便编写自定义的RepresentationModelProcessor，为 Spring Data 仓库查询方法自动暴露的链接添加额外的链接。

items.source: Configuration class registering required components that declare request mappings as beans.
items.translation: 配置类用于注册必需的、声明了请求映射的组件，这些组件被声明为bean。

items.source: RepresentationModelProcessor to add a profile link to the root resource to point to multiple forms of metadata.
items.translation: RepresentationModelProcessor 用于向根资源添加一个 profile 链接，以指向多种形式的元数据。

items.source: A RequestMappingHandlerMapping that augments the request mappings
items.translation: 一个扩展请求映射的RequestMappingHandlerMapping

items.source: Value object to wrap a ServerHttpRequest to provide a slightly more abstract API to find out about the request method.
items.translation: 用于包装 ServerHttpRequest 的值对象，以提供一个稍加抽象的 API 来查询请求方法。

items.source: Builder to create PersistentEntityResource instances.
items.translation: 用于创建PersistentEntityResource实例的构建器。

items.source: Special DispatcherServlet subclass that certain exporter components can recognize.
items.translation: 特殊的 DispatcherServlet 子类，某些导出组件可以识别该子类。

items.source: RequestMappingHandlerAdapter implementation that adds a couple argument resolvers for controller method parameters used in the REST exporter controller.
items.translation: 实现了 `org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method.annotation.RequestMappingHandlerAdapter` 类，并为用于 REST 导出控制器的控制器方法参数添加了一对参数解析器。

items.source: A wrapper for a variety of RepresentationModelAssemblers to avoid having to depend on all of them from our controllers.
items.translation: 一个用于封装多种RepresentationModelAssemblers的包装器，以避免我们的控制器需要依赖所有这些组件。

items.source:
Annotation to declare a controller that declares request mappings to be augmented with a base URI in the Spring Data
REST configuration.
items.translation: 用于声明控制器的注解，该控制器在 Spring Data REST 配置中声明的请求映射将附加一个基础 URI。

items.source: Value object to be able to extract the lookup path within a configured base URI that forms a URI namespace.
items.translation: 值对象用于从配置的基 URI 中提取查找路径，该路径构成一个 URI 命名空间。

items.source: Profile-based controller exposing multiple forms of metadata.
items.translation: 基于档案的控制器，暴露多种形式的元数据。

items.source: Controller for the root resource exposing links to the repository resources.
items.translation: 用于根资源的控制器，提供指向存储库资源的链接。

items.source: Dedicated resource type to represent the links pointing to collection resources exposed for repositories.
items.translation: 专用资源类型，用于表示指向为仓库公开的集合资源的链接。

items.source: Annotation to demarcate Spring MVC controllers provided by Spring Data REST.
items.translation: 用于界定由 Spring Data REST 提供的 Spring MVC 控制器的注解。

items.source: Exception handler for Spring Data REST controllers.
items.translation: Spring Data REST 控制器的异常处理器。

items.source: Indicates a resource was not found.
items.translation: 表示未找到资源。

items.source: Constants to refer to supported media types.
items.translation: 用于引用支持的媒体类型的常量。

items.source: Meta-information about the root repository resource.
items.translation: 根仓库资源的元信息。
